name: sample.sources

list.description: Read synthetic native inquiries in the offline handbook harness.

parameters.name: left-scope
parameters.description: Exact native selection for the left source, independent of the other source.

parameters.name: right-scope
parameters.description: Exact native selection for the right source, independent of the other source.

purpose: Demonstrate qualified native acquisition with host execution and truthful evidence.

fields.name: parentRef
fields.meaning: Reviewed parent reference from the union of both source scopes.

fields.name: left
fields.meaning: Full native left children in source order.

fields.name: right
fields.meaning: Full native right children in source order.

identity_description: Reviewed native parentRef identifies each returned root.
limitations: Educational fixture only; leaf-handbook.invalid is not a production endpoint.
Each source has independent native total and identity; any required-source failure prevents assembly and publication.
Root universe is the union of native parentRef values; the leaf owns this reviewed mapping.
Aggregate reported_total remains null; separate source evidence survives offline replay.

examples.title: Run only in the fake installed-CLI harness
examples.command: dogopencli collection list sample.sources --live --require-complete --left-scope L --right-scope R --limit 0
